text.p: Pro Forma Consolidated Statement of Operations
For the Year Ended September 30, 1996 and 1995
As Reported Adjustments Pro Forma Pro Forma

(A) The pro forma adjustments represent certain previously disclosed charges incurred in connection with the Company's initial public offering. These charges, on a pre-tax basis, consist of special bonuses of $6,087,000 paid to Founders, interest expense on a Founders' note of $1,177,000 and an extraordinary loss on the early extinguishment of bank indebtedness of $907,000.

(B) Prior to May 24, 1996, the Company was an S Corporation. The pro forma income tax provision reflects taxes which would have been recorded on the pro forma pre-tax income if the Company had not been an S Corporation during such periods at an effective rate of 36.0% in 1996 and 40.5% in 1995, reflecting certain income tax planning implemented in 1996.
